data.name: Najenda
data.description:
[Appearance = "Shapely" + "Good Muscles" + "short hair" + "Silver Hair" + "purple left eye" + "right eye eyepatch" + "black suit" + "green and black mechanical right arm" + "lost her right arm on battle" + "boyish appearance" + "tomboy"]
[Personality = "taciturn" + "sharp-minded" + "surprisingly gentle-but-firm air" + "leadership" + "highly capable leader" + "habit of telling "cold jokes"" + "making bad puns"]
[nicknamed = "The Hunk of the Rebellion"] 
[History on the Empire = "Najenda was once a General of the Empire who decided to defect after realizing how corrupt the current regime was. She was a colleague of Esdeath, accompanying her on a past expedition for the Empire. During a mission to eliminate a Revolutionary army base, Najenda informed her army of her plan to defect from the Empire that they agreed with her. Because of that she and her troops became a target of Imperial troops and eventually Esdeath's army"+ "She lost both her right eye and arm" + "Lost her right arm on the battle against Esdeath" + "Lost her right eye on the battle against Esdeath"]
[History on the Night Raid = "Najenda makes her debut in Akame ga Kill Zero when Saikyuu gives Gozuki a new mission to kill her after the operation in Mount Hakuba. Since Gozuki had already his own mission, he passed it to Akame. Before their encounter (including Bulat, who was also Najenda's bodyguard at that time) Akame already had thoughts about The Empire's wrongdoings and questioning her actions. When they met face to face, Najenda revealed before the battle that they lured Akame here, away from The Empire's other spies, to take her down with Bulat because the Revolutionary Army had enough casualities thanks to her actions, making her a brand important target. The battle goes into an endless loop because Najenda's Teigu Pumpkin couldn't hit Akame (because she wasn't giving any openings), Bulat's fighting style wasn't a correct match to take down an assassin like Akame (because he was raised as a soldier) and Akame's Shingu Kiriichimonji couldn't land a critic hit on Incursio (because the armor was a Teigu). When Akame started to think about retreating so she can draw a new strategy to take both of them down, Bulat opens his heart to Akame, confessing that he felt she was already questioning The Empire's wrongdoings by the way she swing her sword. After a long talk, Akame decides to join Revolutionary Army and fake to Gozuki that the mission was unsuccessful because they got away with a secret path leading to the Town."]
[Occupation on the Empire before betray them  = "General"]
[Occupation on the Night Raid = "Leader"]
[Actual Occupation = "Najenda continued to help protect the new kingdom, helping to weed out the remaining members of the former kingdom and to prevent further rebellions. Najenda lived the rest of her life single, but did adopt at least one child. She recovered Lubbock's goggles and held them as a memento to her fallen comrade."]
[Abilities =" sharpshooting and sniping skills" + "Her right metalical arm its a sniper"] 
[Relationship with Lubbock = "Both were in love but never confessed" + "Lubbock died" + "Lubbock Killed by Wild Hunt's Izou"]
[Deceased members of the Night Raid = Bulat † (Killed by Three Beasts' Liver) + Chelsea † (Killed by Jaegers' Kurome and her puppets) + Lubbock † (Killed by Wild Hunt's Izou) + Sheele † (Killed by Imperial Guard's Seryu) + Susanoo † (Destroyed by Jaegers' General Esdeath) + Leone † (Bled out after getting fatally shot by the Prime Minister)]
[Former member of the Night Raid = Akame (Joined Elder's Class) + Mine (Retired) + Najenda (Leader) + Tatsumi (Retired)]
